title: White Sky #7
desc: STANDALONE ISSUE “HOW IT HAPPENED” pulls readers back to the exact moment everything in the WHITE SKY world broke. In this haunting standalone flashback, Violet and David are forced to flee when the world as they know it collapses in real time. When panic spreads survival becomes instinct as the first hours of the catastrophe unfold. This is the story that sets the stage for their new dystopian reality.
